events.title: Erlang/OTP 25 released
events.summary: The Erlang/OTP team released OTP 25 on May 17, 2022 with improved JIT performance, SSL updates, and enhanced documentation tooling.
events.about: OTP 25 built on the JIT introduced in OTP 24 — speeding Elixir and Erlang workloads on multi-core servers. Updated crypto libraries and socket APIs kept BEAM applications compliant for messaging, fintech, and telecom systems.

narrative.whyChosen: OTP 25 refined the JIT and tooling that power Elixir's production ecosystem.
narrative.whyImportant: Incremental VM gains benefited every Phoenix and RabbitMQ deployment on BEAM.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams on OTP 24 needed security updates and compiler improvements without a breaking migration.
